name: SGLang
native_tools: --tool-call-parser <family> (the profile's parsers.sglang), and --reasoning-parser where one exists.

speculation.notes: --speculative-algorithm (EAGLE/EAGLE3, and n-gram in newer releases) with its draft options; the names and supported algorithms differ by version: check python -m sglang.launch_server --help. /get_server_info reports speculative_algorithm when it is on.

notes: /get_server_info also reports the tool_call_parser and context_length the server runs with; crit doctor model shows them.
